Discover our missionShare a prayer request

Faith in action, in everyday places.

The gospel calls us
to care and to go.

Have Compassion on Them Missions brings together believers with a burden to reach others for Christ. Some go. Some intercede. Some provide practical support. Together, we serve.

Our mandate

Restore discipleship

Encourage believers to make disciples in their everyday communities and help others grow in their walk with Christ.

Revive the missionary spirit

Awaken a renewed burden for souls through going, praying, and supporting those on the mission field.

Reach the unreached

Bring the gospel to unreached people and places, with practical care for missionaries and suffering saints.

How can we pray
with you?

Share a prayer request with the ministry, or stand with us as we intercede for souls, missionaries, and communities.
